summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: user requests continuing repairs and protected delivery. Preserve Any-valued ticket outputs.result on reads when no evidence events exist; do not turn valid scalars/lists into unreadable tickets. Keep explicit object requirement when appending evidence.

delivery.outcome: Valid scalar/list execution results survive source/index lookups and updates; evidence appends remain object-only.
nonGoals: No schema, dependencies, storage format, execution authority or synchronization policy changes.

architecture.decision: Return an unchanged projection copy before coercing result when no evidence events exist. Test plain/sharded storage with indexed/source lookups and preserve object-only evidence append rejection.
architecture.rollback: Revert helper early return; no persisted format migration.

validation.evidence: Regression-first API result roundtrip, storage variants, source/index fallback, CAS update and evidence append behavior.
